relations: Hand rotating the black handle tilts the carafe, bringing the cut-off metal lid and spout into view.
Carafe reorientation shifts the visible coffee-surface line angle while the liquid surface stays broadly level.
Turning the curved glass slides room-light and silhouette reflections across the carafe surface.
Background stove, hood, and orange wall remain fixed as the carafe and hand provide the main motion.
caption: The video captures a kitchen interior where a hand grips the black handle of a round glass coffee carafe filled with dark reddish-brown liquid, holding it close to the camera on the right. Behind it, a gas stove supports a black frying pan beneath a metallic range hood and wooden cabinets, while an orange wall, a doorway, and hanging metal tools at the left edge stay at fixed screen positions. Over time the hand slowly rotates and tilts the carafe, so the metal lid and spout assembly, cut off by the upper frame edge at the start, comes into view. As the vessel turns, the visible coffee-surface line shifts and changes angle, while the liquid surface stays broadly level. Bright reflections, including a room-light rectangle and a dark person-silhouette, slide across the curved surface. The black handle and grip rotate, and the metal base appears at the lower right. The background remains still, making the moving carafe and hand the main visible motion. Reorientation continues.
